name: bloodtithe_collector_after_combat_damage_the_opponent_discards
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, each opponent discards a card.' Seat 0's 2/2 attacks unblocked: the opponent loses 2 life this turn. Then Bloodtithe Collector enters: the opponent discards a card (its choice: the Spare); its other card stays in hand.
